description: Model of the TB-303 filter, a four pole diode ladder whose effective attenuation is 18dB per octave

params.text: Sets the frequency where the attenuation starts to take effect
Controls the feedback of the circuit, which emphasises the frequencies around the cutoff
Sets the level of the signal entering the filter
Attenuates and inverts the CV1 input before it is added to the cutoff, despite the manual calling it an attenuator
Attenuates and inverts the CV2 input before it is added to the cutoff, despite the manual calling it an attenuator

inputs.text: The audio input to the filter
A control voltage added to the cutoff, scaled by the CV1 attenuverter
A control voltage added to the cutoff, scaled by the CV2 attenuverter
